cards.front: How many main dimensions does management have (management is multidimensional)?

cards.subject: business_studies
cards.front: What effect can each have on business: higher taxes, technological improvements, political uncertainty, changed consumer tastes?
cards.back:
Effects of environmental changes on business
Increase in taxes by government can make things expensive to buy. Technological improvements may render existing products obsolete. Political uncertainty may create fear in the minds of investors. Changes in fashions and tastes of consumers may shift demand in the market from existing products to new ones.
cards.quote: Increase in taxes by government can make things expensive to buy. Technological improvements may render existing products obsolete. Political uncertainty may create fear in the minds of investors. Changes in fashions and tastes of consumers may shift demand in the market from existing products to new ones.
reasons: review:Illustrative examples of environmental change, not a definition or headed list; four-part answer is not one answer.

cards.subject: business_studies
cards.front: When should actual performance be measured: after the task is completed, or during performance where possible?
cards.back: It is generally believed that measurement should be done after the task is completed. However, wherever possible, measurement of work should be done during the performance.
cards.quote: It is generally believed that measurement should be done after the task is completed. However, wherever possible, measurement of work should be done during the performance.
reasons: review:NCERT says measurement is 'generally' after the task yet 'wherever possible' during; the front is a binary choice that gives the answer away and either side can be defended.

cards.subject: business_studies
cards.front: Borrowing at 10% with a tax rate of 30%: what is the after tax cost of debt?
cards.back: The firms in our examples are borrowing @ 10%. Since the tax rate is 30%, the after tax cost of debt is only 7%.
cards.quote: The firms in our examples are borrowing @ 10%. Since the tax rate is 30%, the after tax cost of debt is only 7%.

source.section: Factors affecting the Choice of Capital Structure

reasons: review:Worked-example arithmetic (10% borrowing, 30% tax gives 7%) taken from the illustration; not a definition, list, formula or fact worth memorising. Front is self-contained but the point is trivia.

cards.front: What do intermediaries do for the firm, in the place element of the marketing mix?

Activities of intermediaries
The intermediaries in turn keep inventory of the firm's products, demonstrate them to potential buyers, negotiate price with buyers, close sales and also service the products after the sale.
